blocks.title: AMENITIES AND WELL-LIVING
blocks.text: AMENITIES AND WELL-LIVING Discover the most extensive well-living and amenities program in the UAE, across a 26,000 square metre central oasis, all set within resort-style landscaping designed by Vladimir Djurovic. Reflection, texture, and tropical density create an immersive calm that guides you from forest to water, sun to shade, and privacy to openness, all while regulating temperature and setting a natural pace.
